ask: Vertical inspection of the test suite: 43,000 lines across crew/*.test.mjs, test/*.test.mjs, skills/**/*.test.mjs, commands/*.test.mjs and crew/pi/extensions/*.test.mjs. Report: helpers and fixtures implemented in more than one test file that test/helpers.mjs or test/fixtures.mjs could own (quote both copies); vacuous tests — a test that passes while proving nothing, such as an assertion on a value the test itself set, a degraded-path test that reads state before the lazy open that would populate it, a both-directions pin with only one direction, a try/catch that swallows the failing assertion; tests whose name promises more than the assertion checks; the slowest files and tests by measured duration and what makes them slow; fixed sleeps standing in for conditions (the daemon.test.mjs sweep just landed — check the other files); tests that spawn real processes or open real sockets where a fake would prove the same thing; and test-only exports in runtime modules. Measure durations by running the suite with node --test's per-test timing, do not estimate.
done_means: A ranked findings register. Sections: duplicated helpers (both locations, proposed home, number of files that would shrink); vacuous tests (file:line, what it claims, why it cannot fail, the assertion that would make it honest); name-versus-assertion mismatches; a duration table of the ten slowest files and ten slowest tests with the measured ms and the cause; fixed-sleep sweep results per file with the grep quoted; real-process and real-socket tests with a yes/no on whether a fake would prove the same property and why. Every vacuity claim is demonstrated, not asserted: show the mutation to the code under test that the test FAILS to catch, or the inverted assertion that still passes. The register states which test files were read in full and which were sampled, with the sampling rule.
out_of_scope: No edits. No proposal that deletes a test without naming what still pins the property it covered. No opinion on runtime code except as a test-only export. No change to package.json's test script or timeout. Runtime duplication is another scout's surface.
